description.value: Happy Lamb Hot Pot is a Canadian Mongolian-style hot pot chain with 11 locations, offering individual hot pots with a signature slow-simmered broth made from hens, beef bones, and 36 herbal ingredients including goji berries and ginseng. The Coquitlam location is a full sit-down restaurant with both all-you-can-eat and à la carte options, making it a solid stop for a substantial, warming meal. The chain has earned a strong following in the Lower Mainland for its broth quality and generous portions.
